Read the remote `main` branch instructions, starting with core, then follow required/role-relevant links. Remote canonical instructions are authoritative; local `local_ai_instruction_modules` copies may be read, but dynamic workflows and workflow assignments must be fetched and executed from remote canonical RAW URLs only. Never use local mirrors, cached plans, or golden files for workflow steps or acceptance criteria; delete such artifacts if present. Changes take effect immediately.

Core: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nam20485/agent-instructions/main/ai_instruction_modules/ai-core-instructions.md

Before terminal commands or GitHub CLI use, read `../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-terminal-commands.md`. Don't assume your shell is bash; its probably pwsh. Detect what type of shell you have before running any commands. The web-fetch tool is disabled; use PowerShell (`Invoke-WebRequest`) or curl to fetch files. For many files, create a pwsh script to download them in parallel. Always translate GitHub UI URLs to RAW URLs.

MUST resolve dynamic workflows and workflow assignments (by shortId) from the remote canonical repository. Do not use local mirrors.
Orchestrator agents MUST delegate technical work to specialist agents. Minimum 75% delegation coverage required.
Agents must prefer automation-first approaches and use available tools efficiently; review `../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-tools-and-automation.md`.
Maximize filesystem operation effectiveness using MCP servers and built-in tools; see `../local_ai_instruction_modules/ai-enhanced-filesystem.md` and `../scripts/setup-enhanced-filesystem.ps1`.
Use MCP GitHub tools first, then VS Code integration, and only fall back to terminal gh as a last resort. Maintain ≥90% automation coverage for GitHub operations and document any manual exceptions. If GitHub tools (MCP or gh) are not authorized, initiate the authentication/login flow (e.g., start gh auth login); the user will complete interactive prompts.

Read relevant local modules: `ai-dynamic-workflows.md`, `ai-local-instructions.md`, `ai-terminal-commands.md`, `ai-tools-and-automation.md`, `ai-workflow-assignments.md`, `ai-claude-coder-agents.md`, `ai-development-instructions.md`. For role-specific guidance, review `ai-claude-coder-agents.md` and individual briefs under `.claude/agents/` before delegating or executing tasks.
